statusDefinitions.BASE_DIRECT: Loaded directly by the application HTML before the additive runtime bootstrap. It may be foundational without owning the final visible UI.
statusDefinitions.FOUNDATION_REQUIRED: Current foundational shell or host layer required by later runtime owners. It may be visually superseded while still providing DOM, classes, globals or lifecycle hooks that later modules depend on.
statusDefinitions.FINAL_OWNER: Known current owner/finalizer for a visible runtime area. Later modules may still decorate it.
statusDefinitions.COMPATIBILITY: Required bridge, adapter, safety wrapper or migration layer. Do not infer UI ownership from this file.
statusDefinitions.LOADED_LEGACY_CANDIDATE: Still loaded in production but likely superseded in visible behavior. Must not be removed until callers, globals, events and smoke tests are traced.
statusDefinitions.LEGACY_FALLBACK_REQUIRED: Legacy layer intentionally retained because a current user-accessible fallback still depends on its behavior. Do not retire it until that fallback is removed or replaced.
statusDefinitions.ACTIVE_PROVIDER: Conditionally active runtime provider loaded outside the main bootstrap.
statusDefinitions.DYNAMIC_CURRENT: Current production module loaded dynamically by another current runtime file rather than by the main bootstrap.
statusDefinitions.LOADED_CURRENT_UNCLASSIFIED: Loaded by the production bootstrap and therefore treated as required until explicitly classified.

areas.note: Workspace Architecture provides the shell. Task Source Actions v15 remains the safe shell/navigation reconciler. Operating Experience v1 is the late presentation/navigation layer loaded by the redesign finalizer: it exposes Home, Opportunities, Projects, Partners, Finance and System as the primary business zones, applies distinct zone colors, and performs no business-data writes or outbound actions.

Workspace Architecture may create the Home shell during startup, but Home Canonical is the sole final data owner. Current Home is an event/action engine: maximum five concrete actions, waiting separated from action, Project Brief drill-down and obsolete-task reconciliation. Operating Experience may decorate Home and route Vepro directly to an existing decision surface, but does not own Home data/state.

Project-First remains the data/tool workspace and Canonical Project Workflow remains the UI workflow reconciler over the existing engines. Operating Experience is the later presentation layer that groups the project into Përgatitja, Prokurimi, Komerciale, Ekzekutimi and Financa, keeps Skedarët/Komunikimi as utilities, and makes Hapi i radhës lifecycle-aware without replacing BOM/RFQ/comparison/pricing/client-offer engines or human gates.

Contact Master is the daily relationship register over canonical contacts/contact_sources/project_contacts. Gmail, HubSpot and Bitrix24 remain source systems/back-office capabilities; classic contacts remain a fallback.

The first filename is legacy. The current tender UI/business layer covers KRPP Kosovo, APP Albania, TED direct-bid opportunities and TED award-winner outreach. Operating Experience adds only the final GO / REVIEW / NO-GO presentation and does not change tender status/project-promotion gates.

GPT-OSS provider is dynamically loaded and becomes active only after explicit activation in the browser. Project Intelligence resilience remains the final analysis guard; the conversation module is an explicit, read-only discussion layer over the existing project brief and current PPPP data.
